label: Every actual root gives in a uniform mode: two-way toward one effect, two-way toward each
paraphrase: OPEN (analyst formulation, unattributed): every actual root of the selected grounding relation G at w gives in a uniform mode (UniformGivingModeAt): if it is two-way toward some effect at w (gives it being at w and withholds it at an accessible world where the root exists), it is two-way toward every being it gives being at w. Excludes a mixed-mode root, fixed toward one effect and two-way toward another. Not entailed by one power, an invariant set-up and willed exercise (controls, mixed-mode root).
